title: Three Kingdoms 8: Reunification of the Three Kingdoms Under Jin

series.title: Three Kingdoms 8: Reunification of the Three Kingdoms Under Jin

fullText.simplified:
第五章、看清现实

    从马真箭下逃出来的姜维来到一片树林。既心寒又悲伤的他想到季城里不知生死的母亲，眼泪控制不住地流了下来。
    “伯约，我已经在这儿等你很久了。”忽然，一个温和的声音飘进了他的耳朵。
    他吃了一惊，马上回头。远处的大树下站着一个高大的中年男人，白衣白帽，正微笑望着自己。那笑容温和明亮，沉静干净，让人感觉十分舒服。
    “诸葛亮？”姜维迟疑道，他握紧了手中的刀：“你一个人？真大胆！”
    他举刀冲了过去，刀就要落在诸葛亮的头上了，但诸葛亮没有动。
    “你不躲？”姜维停刀问。
    “我知道你不会杀我。”诸葛亮微笑道。
    姜维默默放下刀，道：“我母亲一直叫我伯约，刚才你也叫我伯约，语气还和我母亲一样，你见过我母亲了？”
    诸葛亮点头道：“来这儿以前，我在季城和你母亲见了一面。她是位既优秀又有远见的母亲，我很尊敬她。”
    “你见我母亲做什么？你希望她帮你？帮你叫我投降？”
    诸葛亮微笑道：“我见你母亲是想多了解你。我们只聊了一些小事。她和我说了一些你小时候的事，我给她说了我以前的事，我们聊得还不错。虽然我期待你投降，但我没有对你母亲说。你母亲说，伯约是个拥有远大志向而且聪明勇敢的孩子，我知道这句话就够了。”
    姜维沉默了一会儿，问道：“你对马真用了什么计？他为什么说我投降你了？”
    “我的计策很简单，就是找了一个长得像你的人，假装成你的样子带着我的兵去攻天水城，马真马上就相信你已经向我投降了。”
    “你——你害了我！”
    “我只是让你看清现实。如果马真真的信任你，我的计策能成功吗？你这么聪明，一定也想得明白。也许平时你就发现过，他不是真正地信任你，你的真心付错了地方。”
    “他的信任不重要。只要能守护天水和母亲，我不在乎。”姜维咬牙道。
    诸葛亮欣慰地看着姜维，赞叹道：“好伯约！我相信你！但你的不在乎并不能保全自己。虽然今天马真没有杀死你，但以后呢？他这么轻易就要杀你，别人是不是也会像他这样对待你呢？如果你连保全自己都做不到，那还怎么守护天水和母亲呢？”
    “我忠君爱国，不会做投降的小人。”姜维再咬牙道。
    诸葛亮笑了笑，说道：“忠君爱国没有错，但你忠的是什么君？爱的是什么国？”
    心像是被什么东西敲打，姜维吃惊地看向诸葛亮，嘴里却回答不了他的问题。
fullText.traditional:
第五章、看清現實

    從馬真箭下逃出來的姜維來到一片樹林。既心寒又悲傷的他想到季城裡不知生死的母親，眼淚控制不住地流了下來。
    “伯約，我已經在這兒等你很久了。”忽然，一個溫和的聲音飄進了他的耳朵。
    他吃了一驚，馬上回頭。遠處的大樹下站著一個高大的中年男人，白衣白帽，正微笑望著自己。那笑容溫和明亮，沉靜乾淨，讓人感覺十分舒服。
    “諸葛亮？”姜維遲疑道，他握緊了手中的刀：“你一個人？真大膽！”
    他舉刀衝了過去，刀就要落在諸葛亮的頭上了，但諸葛亮沒有動。
    “你不躲？”姜維停刀問。
    “我知道你不會殺我。”諸葛亮微笑道。
    姜維默默放下刀，道：“我母親一直叫我伯約，剛才你也叫我伯約，語氣還和我母親一樣，你見過我母親了？”
    諸葛亮點頭道：“來這兒以前，我在季城和你母親見了一面。她是位既優秀又有遠見的母親，我很尊敬她。”
    “你見我母親做什麼？你希望她幫你？幫你叫我投降？”
    諸葛亮微笑道：“我見你母親是想多了解你。我們只聊了一些小事。她和我說了一些你小時候的事，我給她說了我以前的事，我們聊得還不錯。雖然我期待你投降，但我沒有對你母親說。你母親說，伯約是個擁有遠大志向而且聰明勇敢的孩子，我知道這句話就夠了。”
    姜維沉默了一會兒，問道：“你對馬真用了什麼計？他為什麼說我投降你了？”
    “我的計策很簡單，就是找了一個長得像你的人，假裝成你的樣子帶著我的兵去攻天水城，馬真馬上就相信你已經向我投降了。”
    “你——你害了我！”
    “我只是讓你看清現實。如果馬真真的信任你，我的計策能成功嗎？你這麼聰明，一定也想得明白。也許平時你就發現過，他不是真正地信任你，你的真心付錯了地方。”
    “他的信任不重要。只要能守護天水和母親，我不在乎。”姜維咬牙道。
    諸葛亮欣慰地看著姜維，讚嘆道：“好伯約！我相信你！但你的不在乎並不能保全自己。雖然今天馬真沒有殺死你，但以後呢？他這麼輕易就要殺你，別人是不是也會像他這樣對待你呢？如果你連保全自己都做不到，那還怎麼守護天水和母親呢？”
    “我忠君愛國，不會做投降的小人。”姜維再咬牙道。
    諸葛亮笑了笑，說道：“忠君愛國沒有錯，但你忠的是什麼君？愛的是什麼國？”
    心像是被什麼東西敲打，姜維吃驚地看向諸葛亮，嘴裡卻回答不了他的問題。

sentences.simplified: 他这么轻易就要杀你，别人是不是也会像他这样对待你呢？
sentences.traditional: 他這麼輕易就要殺你，別人是不是也會像他這樣對待你呢？
sentences.pinyin: tā zhè me qīng yì jiù yào shā nǐ bié ren shì bú shì yě huì xiàng tā zhè yàng duì dài nǐ ne
sentences.english: He was so quick to want to kill you. Won’t others treat you the same way?

sentences.simplified: 如果你连保全自己都做不到，那还怎么守护天水和母亲呢？”
sentences.traditional: 如果你連保全自己都做不到，那還怎麼守護天水和母親呢？”
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ lián bǎo quán zì jǐ dōu zuò bú dào nà hái zěn me shǒu hù tiān shuǐ hé mǔ qīn ne
sentences.english: If you can’t even protect yourself, how can you safeguard Tianshui and your mother?”

sentences.simplified: “我忠君爱国，不会做投降的小人。”
sentences.traditional: “我忠君愛國，不會做投降的小人。”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zhōng jūn ài guó bú huì zuò tóu xiáng de xiǎo rén
sentences.english: “I am loyal to my ruler and love my country. I will not become a despicable person who surrenders,” ..

sentences.simplified: 姜维再咬牙道。
sentences.traditional: 姜維再咬牙道。
sentences.pinyin: jiāng wéi zài yǎo yá dào
sentences.english: .. Jiang Wei said, gritting his teeth once more.

sentences.simplified: 诸葛亮笑了笑，说道：
sentences.traditional: 諸葛亮笑了笑，說道：
sentences.pinyin: zhū gě liàng xiào le xiào shuō dào
sentences.english: Zhuge Liang smiled and said, ..

sentences.simplified: “忠君爱国没有错，但你忠的是什么君？爱的是什么国？”
sentences.traditional: “忠君愛國沒有錯，但你忠的是什麼君？愛的是什麼國？”
sentences.pinyin: zhōng jūn ài guó méi yǒu cuò dàn nǐ zhōng de shì shén me jūn ài de shì shén me guó
sentences.english: .. “It’s good that you are loyal to your ruler and love your country, but to which ruler are you loyal? Which country do you love?”

sentences.simplified: 心像是被什么东西敲打，姜维吃惊地看向诸葛亮，嘴里却回答不了他的问题。
sentences.traditional: 心像是被什麼東西敲打，姜維吃驚地看向諸葛亮，嘴裡卻回答不了他的問題。
sentences.pinyin: xīn xiàng shì bèi shén me dōng xi qiāo dǎ jiāng wéi chī jīng de kàn xiàng zhū gě liàng zuǐ lǐ què huí dá bù liǎo tā de wèn tí
sentences.english: It felt as if his heart had been struck by something. Jiang Wei looked at Zhuge Liang in shock but was unable to answer his question.

sentence_translations: Chapter 5: Seeing the Reality of the Situation
Jiang Wei, who escaped from Ma Zhen’s arrows, came to some woods.
Feeling both disheartened and sorrowful, he thought of his mother in Jicheng, who he didn’t know was dead or alive.
Tears uncontrollably streamed down his face.
“Boyue, I’ve been waiting for you here for a long time.” Suddenly, a gentle voice drifted into his ears.
He was startled and immediately turned around.
Under a big tree in the distance stood a tall, middle-aged man dressed in white clothes and a white hat, smiling to himself.
That smile was gentle and bright, calm and pure, making one feel very comfortable.
“Zhuge Liang?” Jiang Wei hesitated, gripping the sword in his hand tightly, “You’re alone? That’s pretty bold!”
He raised his sword and charged forward, about to bring the sword down on Zhuge Liang’s head, but Zhuge Liang didn’t move.
“Aren’t you going to get out of the way?” Jiang Wei halted his sword and asked.
“I know you won’t kill me,” Zhuge Liang said with a smile.
Jiang Wei silently lowered his sword and said, “My mother always calls me Boyue, and just now, you also called me Boyue.
Your tone was just like my mother’s. Have you met her before?”
Zhuge Liang nodded and said, “Before I came here, I met your mother in Jicheng.
She is an exceptional and visionary mother, and I have great respect for her.”
“Why did you meet my mother? Were you hoping she’d help you? Help you persuade me to surrender?”
Zhuge Liang smiled and said, “I met your mother because I wanted to know more about you. We only talked about some trivial matters.
She told me some stories about your childhood, and I shared some of my past with her. We had a good conversation.
Although I hope for your surrender, I didn’t mention it to your mother.
Your mother said that Boyue is a child with great ambitions, intelligence, and courage. Knowing that is enough for me.”
Jiang Wei was silent for a moment, then asked, “What plan did you use on Ma Zhen? Why did he say I surrendered to you?”
“My plan was very simple.
I simply found someone who looks like you to impersonate you and lead my troops to attack Tianshui.
Ma Zhen immediately believed that you had surrendered to me.”
“You … you set me up!”
“I’m just letting you see the reality of the situation. If Ma Zhen truly trusted you, would my plan have succeeded?
You’re very intelligent. I’m sure you can figure it out.
Perhaps you’ve noticed before that he never truly trusted you, and your loyalty was misplaced.”
“His trust doesn’t matter. As long as I can protect Tianshui and my mother, I don’t care,” Jiang Wei said through gritted teeth.
Zhuge Liang looked at Jiang Wei with satisfaction and exclaimed, “Good Boyue! I believe in you!
But your indifference cannot protect you. Although Ma Zhen didn’t kill you today, what about in the future?
He was so quick to want to kill you. Won’t others treat you the same way?
If you can’t even protect yourself, how can you safeguard Tianshui and your mother?”
“I am loyal to my ruler and love my country. I will not become a despicable person who surrenders,” ..
.. Jiang Wei said, gritting his teeth once more.
Zhuge Liang smiled and said, ..
.. “It’s good that you are loyal to your ruler and love your country, but to which ruler are you loyal? Which country do you love?”
It felt as if his heart had been struck by something. Jiang Wei looked at Zhuge Liang in shock but was unable to answer his question.
